question: How much will Nvidia's stock price returns exceed Apple's in these biweekly periods of Q3 2026? (Sep 21 - Oct 2)

calls.reasoning: Reference class: rolling 10-trading-day windows of NVDA minus AAPL returns, Sep 2023-Sep 2026; median roughly +0.5 pts over the full class, about -0.4 pts over the 2026-YTD subset where the AI-infra-to-Apple rotation reversed the trend. Ten trading days (Sep 21-Oct 2) contain no earnings for either name, which is why NVDA's 30-day IV sits at ~34.5% with IV rank ~8 and VIX at ~17 despite 5% 10-yr yields and $105-110 oil. Bull tilt for NVDA: +8.7% over the past four weeks, market cap back above Apple, 27.6x trailing vs Apple's 38x, sell-side target $327 (+51%) vs Apple's $324 (below spot), Micron's Sep 30 print (~$50.8B, +350% y/y) as an AI-demand read-through, and a beta-2.22 vs 1.09 gearing to any relief rally. Bear tilt: the Sep 14 Amodei/Altman/Musk 'slow AI down' shock (NVDA -3.4%, SOX -6%) is unresolved headline risk aimed squarely at NVDA, SOX is ~19% off highs, memory pricing is a stated NVDA gross-margin headwind, China DC compute guided to zero, and a hiking Fed plus 5% yields punishes the higher-beta name. These roughly cancel, so I keep the median near zero (+0.4) with a slightly lower mean for negative skew, and spend my effort on dispersion. Both bounds are open: a macro/AI-narrative air pocket or a melt-up in AI semis can push the spread past +/-15 (2.3 sigma), and fat tails in this pair justify ~3.5% below / ~3.0% above rather than the ~1% each a Gaussian would give. No human market prices this spread; Polymarket's NVDA level markets are a wrong-instrument near-miss, so no blending.

calls.reference_class: Rolling 10-trading-day (two-week) windows of NVDA price return minus AAPL price return, trailing 12 months Sep 2025-Sep 2026, restricted to windows containing no earnings report for either name; 2023-2025 windows of the same class used only for regime contrast

calls.reasoning: Ten trading days, no earnings for either name, no dated NVDA event in the window: the median is near zero and the entire forecast is dispersion sizing plus open-bound pricing. Base rate from the 2026 rotation regime is about -0.4pp per window (NVDA +15.6% YTD vs AAPL +22.4% over ~17.5 windows); I lift the center marginally positive because three in-window effects align - AAPL post-iPhone-18-release sell-the-news at an all-time high with a consensus target below spot and an 11% Sell share, Sep 30 quarter-end rebalancing away from the +8.8%-month winner toward the -4.2%-month laggard, and short-horizon cross-sectional reversal off NVDA's 9% drawdown - offset by the unresolved Amodei/Altman AI-slowdown derating (SOX -6% on Sep 14) and NVDA's 2.2 beta into a just-hiked Fed, 5% 10-year and $105+ oil, which I carry as left skew rather than a lower median. Dispersion: NVDA 34% implied (earnings-free stretch, IV rank ~8) and AAPL 23% realized with a regime-depressed correlation near 0.3 give a 7.0pp spread SD, so a 16.2pp interior 10-90 after escape mass. Micron's Sep 30 FQ4 print is the one scheduled in-window trigger for either tail. Human markets: I confirmed the runs' finding that nothing prices this spread - Polymarket's Dec-2026 largest-company market and NVDA level markets are the wrong instrument and horizon, Kalshi's single-stock perps are only filed with the CFTC, and the harness-supplied Manifold Big-Tech-vs-Bitcoin market (0.84, volume 2,939, closes 2030) matches on neither comparator, horizon nor quantity; no blend.
calls.reconciliation: Disputes were: (a) the 2026-YTD base rate, (b) which NVDA volatility applies, (c) the sign of the pair correlation, (d) whether the tape is calm or stressed, (e) whether trailing 24-session underperformance is drift, (f) interior width. (a) settled against Run 2: its -0.9pp rests on a stale 'NVDA +7-10% YTD' figure its own dossier attributes to a July article, while the Sep 16 numbers (+15.61% vs +22.42%) give -0.39pp per window - I adopt Runs 1/3's -0.4. (b) settled by instrument choice: the window is earnings-free, so NVDA's 34.5% 30-day implied is the applicable input; Run 3's 0.442 realized is contaminated by Aug 27/28 (its own estimate: ~42% of window variance, leaving ~0.35) and Run 2's 28% is the low outlier from 24 sessions. (c) NOT settled - Run 2's rho = -0.3 has SE ~0.2 at n=24 and includes an earnings day, so it is statistically indistinguishable from mildly positive, but the rotation regime does depress the long-run 0.45-0.55; I take rho ~= 0.3 and the resulting 7.0pp SD carries that uncertainty. (d) NOT settled - quoted VIX 17.2 and NVDA IV rank 8 versus one secondary outlet's 'downturn' framing; I weight the option market for dispersion since it is the direct instrument. (e) judgment, resolved against extrapolation: at 1-4 weeks single-name cross-sectional reversal dominates continuation, so -5.6pp/10d is an episode reading not a drift term. (f) arithmetic once escapes are declared - Run 2 declared 4.5%/4.0% escape mass and an untruncated 18.8pp interior, double-counting the tails; 7.0pp SD implies 17.9pp unconditional and ~16.2pp inside the bounds. I also note a factual gap no run could close: whether the return is measured from the Sep 18 close or the Sep 21 open is unspecified (the resolution-criteria, fine-print and background sections were supplied empty), which argues against narrowing further, and I did not narrow. My center sits just above all three runs because the post-launch, quarter-end and reversal effects align in the same modest direction while the AI-derating risk is priced as skew; this is a reconciled reading, not an average.

disagreements.verdict: Settled on ~34% (30-day implied). The window contains no earnings, so forward implied over an earnings-free stretch is the right input; Run 3's 0.442 is earnings-contaminated (~0.35 stripped), Run 2's 28% is a 24-session low outlier.

disagreements.claim: Current NVDA/AAPL daily correlation is negative (-0.3) rather than +0.35 to +0.55
disagreements.verdict: Could NOT be settled from the dossiers: n=24 gives SE ~0.2 and the sample includes an earnings day. Took rho ~= 0.3 - depressed below the long-run level by the rotation regime but not negative - and let the 7.0pp SD carry the residual uncertainty.

disagreements.claim: The tape is calm (VIX 17.2, NVDA IV rank 8) vs stressed (5% yields, $110 oil, equity downturn)
disagreements.verdict: Could NOT be settled; the 'downturn' framing traces to one secondary outlet. Weighted the option-market numbers for dispersion because they price the instrument directly, while keeping the macro risk as left skew.

disagreements.claim: Trailing 24-session NVDA underperformance (-13.8pp, about -5.6pp per 10 days) should carry into the window as drift
disagreements.verdict: Rejected. At 1-4 week horizons single-name cross-sectional reversal dominates momentum; treated as an episode, and its mirror image (NVDA 9% off its Sep 4 high) as a mild positive.

disagreements.claim: Interior 10-90 width should be 18.8pp rather than 15-16pp
disagreements.verdict: Resolved by arithmetic: 7.0pp SD implies 17.9pp unconditional; declaring 3.5%/3.0% escape past the open bounds leaves 16.2pp inside. Run 2 declared both fat escapes and full untruncated width.

disagreements.claim: Some human market anchors this spread
disagreements.verdict: All three runs agree none does, and the harness candidate (Manifold Big Tech vs Bitcoin, closes 2030) matches on no dimension. No blend applied.
